verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a local API bundled with the desktop app, a headless CLI server, an official MCP server, chat endpoints, an agents skill that can read, search and modify Objects, and a gRPC API, so a substantial programmatic surface exists. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that this surface matches the UI, and much of what the UI offers is only documented as UI features. Missing for 10: documented UI/API parity, API coverage of publishing, templates, queries/views, types, sharing and import/export, a published API reference (the OpenAPI probe paths on the docs site returned 404), and independent hands-on confirmation.
